name: Anker Nano Power Bank (10K, 30W, built-in USB-C cable)
caption:
Never pack a separate charging cable again. 🔋

The Anker Nano power bank has a USB-C cable built in, holds 10,000 mAh and charges at up to 30W. It also has a USB-C port and a USB-A port.

Tip: Anker says it recharges to about half in around 45 minutes.
